TwistedPairServer.title: Twisted Pair Server
TwistedPairServer.description: Host Twisted Pair yourself: the server and its Postgres database, in Docker
TwistedPairServer.how: Run `git clone https://git.phin.tech/sam/twisted-pair.git`, copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill it in, then run `docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build`. Needs Docker. For people outside your network, put a TLS proxy in front of it.
